experiment.topic: BTC-USD hourly extreme return mean reversion
experiment.hypothesis: BTC-USD hourly returns exceeding +2% are followed by a statistically significant negative return within the next 12 hours, indicating mean reversion.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For each hour in the dataset where BTC-USD returns exceed +2.0% in the last 12 hours, check whether the next 12 hours show a statistically significant negative return (p < 0.05 via t-test) using only hourly close prices. If no such negative return occurs in any case, the hypothesis is falsified.
